bugs_found: contract-validate ignores schema validation errors: it prints 'schema OK' and iterates over an empty list instead of reporting actual errors, so invalid contracts pass CI
review-gate docstring requires latest round overall to have verdict=approve, but the implementation never checks the latest overall round verdict
review-gate deduplicates findings using lexicographic filename order instead of round metadata, so the 'latest ack' can be wrong if filenames do not sort exactly by review chronology
review-validate and contract-validate load schema files without handling FileNotFoundError/JSONDecodeError, causing crashes instead of documented configuration exit code 2
